title: incident-bot: integrate slo-toolkit runbook scoring and on-call helper heuristics
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot runbook suggestion ranking by integrating SLO Toolkit scoring heuristics and adds on-call helper heuristics; includes telemetry and docs. No breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: runbook suggestions surfaced by incident-bot were noisy in high-churn services and lacked SLO-aware ranking. This PR integrates a lightweight runbook scoring utility from slo-toolkit into incident-bot suggestion pipelines and adds a set of on-call helper heuristics (service criticality, recent change windows, and SLO impact) to improve precision of automated diagnostics and quick-links.

What I changed: - Added slo-toolkit runbook scoring adapter (deterministic, configurable weights) and a feature flag to enable gradual rollout. - Implemented on-call helper heuristics inside incident-bot that demote stale runbooks and prefer runbooks with explicitly-linked SLOs. - Added telemetry counters and histograms for suggestion latency, score distribution, and selection rate. - Updated unit/integration tests and added evaluation harness comparing previous vs new ranking on historical incidents. - Docs: updated oncall/runbooks.md and incident-bot README with rollout instructions and feature-flag knobs.

Checklist: - [x] New scoring util (slo-toolkit) with unit tests - [x] incident-bot integration and feature flag - [x] Telemetry and dashboard links - [x] Integration tests + eval harness - [x] Docs and rollout notes

Rollout plan: 1) Enable feature-flag in beta for a small set of services (canary) 2) Monitor score distributions and suggestion acceptance rate (dashboard links included) 3) Increase coverage and adjust weights via ENG-3654 after 1 week of telemetry

Notes: This is opt-in behind incident-bot.feature_flags.runbook_scoring to avoid surprise behavior for customers. Related: ENG-3654, ENG-3678. For support escalations, see SUP-9012.
